test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

Mrs. Rani / works for / a international / school.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the article "**a**" before the term "**international**."
 
• The correct article to use before a word starting with a vowel sound is "**an**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**an international**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mrs. Rani works for **an international** school."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mrs. Rani** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **works for** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **school** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
